verdict.rationale: AWS documents the Cost Explorer API for programmatically querying cost and usage data, which covers the queryable billing/cost API part of the story. The pack has no evidence of scheduled cost exports or resource-level granularity; Budgets alerts are an adjacent control and earn no credit. missing for 10: scheduled/recurring cost data exports, resource-level cost granularity, independent or hands-on corroboration of API depth.
